citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (allo-HSCT) trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.dosageRange: Varies by preparative regimen and stem cell source
treatments.name: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (allo-HSCT)

primaryOutcomes.name: Cumulative Incidence of Relapse (CIR) at 2 Years

secondaryOutcomes.baseline: EORTC QLQ-C30 Global Health Status score (pre-transplant): 50 points (0-100 scale)
secondaryOutcomes.name: Quality of Life (QoL) - EORTC QLQ-C30 Global Health Status
Cumulative Incidence of Chronic GVHD (cGVHD) at 2 Years

treatments.treatmentDuration: Initial hospitalization 1-2 months, intensive outpatient 6-12 months, lifetime follow-up

citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Cytarabine + Daunorubicin ("7+3" Induction Chemotherapy) trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.dosageRange: Cytarabine 100-200 mg/m² daily for 7 days; Daunorubicin 45-60 mg/m² daily for 3 days
treatments.name: Cytarabine + Daunorubicin ("7+3" Induction Chemotherapy)

primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Reduced to <5% of nucleated cells (e.g., from 70% to 2%)
primaryOutcomes.baseline: Typical at diagnosis: 60-80% of nucleated cells
primaryOutcomes.name: Bone Marrow Blasts

primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Reduced to 0% of white blood cells (e.g., from 45% to 0%)
primaryOutcomes.baseline: Typical at diagnosis: 30-60% of white blood cells
primaryOutcomes.name: Peripheral Blood Blasts

primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Reduced from leukocytosis to normal range (<10,000/uL)
primaryOutcomes.name: White Blood Cell Count

secondaryOutcomes.baseline: Average at diagnosis: 2-3 (on a scale of 0=fully active to 5=dead)
secondaryOutcomes.name: ECOG Performance Status

secondaryOutcomes.baseline: Average at diagnosis: 45-55/100 (lower score indicates worse QoL)
secondaryOutcomes.name: EORTC QLQ-C30 Global Health Status Score

secondaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Increased by 3-5 g/dL (e.g., from 9.0 to 13.0 g/dL)
secondaryOutcomes.name: Hemoglobin Level

treatments.treatmentDuration: Induction (7+3 days) then 3-4 consolidation cycles (total 4-6 months)

citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Venetoclax + Azacitidine trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.dosageRange: Venetoclax 400 mg daily; Azacitidine 75 mg/m² daily for 7 days of a 28-day cycle
treatments.name: Venetoclax + Azacitidine

secondaryOutcomes.name: Red Blood Cell Transfusion Units per 28 days

treatments.treatmentDuration: Continuous until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: CPX-351 (Liposomal Cytarabine and Daunorubicin) trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.dosageRange: Cytarabine 100 mg/m² and Daunorubicin 44 mg/m² IV on days 1, 3, 5
treatments.name: CPX-351 (Liposomal Cytarabine and Daunorubicin)

primaryOutcomes.name: Complete Remission (CR) or CR with Incomplete Hematologic Recovery (CRi) Rate

secondaryOutcomes.name: Duration of Complete Remission (CR) or CR with Incomplete Hematologic Recovery (CRi)

citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Midostaurin + Chemotherapy trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.dosageRange: Midostaurin 50 mg orally twice daily, Days 8-21 of induction/consolidation, then continuously
treatments.name: Midostaurin + Chemotherapy

secondaryOutcomes.name: Complete Remission or Incomplete Recovery (CR+CRi) Rate

treatments.timeToEffect: Starts with chemotherapy, effects seen with prolonged remission
treatments.treatmentDuration: Concurrent with induction/consolidation, then maintenance for up to 12 months

citations.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Gemtuzumab Ozogamicin (GO) + Chemotherapy trials for Acute myeloid leukemia

treatments.name: Gemtuzumab Ozogamicin (GO) + Chemotherapy
treatments.timeToEffect: Starts with chemotherapy, effects seen with improved EFS/OS
